nimcet.note: Use official 2025 / 2026 opening and closing RANK reports. Choose the year, institute, category and counselling round. Ranks cannot be substituted for marks.

cuet.note: There is no single national admission cutoff. Choose your university and PG programme, then check that university’s category- and round-specific allocation lists.

upsc.note: Official CSE 2024 and 2025 cutoff PDFs are available in the archive. Select the category and distinguish Prelims GS-I, Mains and Final. Use the exact official report for the matching year and stage.

bank.note: Choose SBI or IBPS, recruitment year, PO / clerical / specialist role, stage, category and (where relevant) state. Historical marks utilities and notices are cycle-specific; no universal banking cutoff exists.

ese.note: Use the official Engineering Services 2024 / 2025 cutoff reports. Select branch, category and stage: written, Mains and final thresholds are different.

psu.note: There is no single PSU / ISRO / DRDO exam or cutoff. Open the exact vacancy, discipline, category and recruitment cycle; use its own shortlist and final-selection notice.

gre.note: GRE, GMAT, IELTS and TOEFL have different scales. There is no universal admission pass mark. Use the target university’s programme, score-validity and language requirements.
